_comment: Google Drive links for each knowledge-base piece.
Upload the piece files from kb/ to Google Drive, then paste the link
here, keyed by the piece id from kb/manifest.json.
A folder link works and is simpler to manage:
So does a link to a single file:
The verification engine checks each link before it is stored, so make
sure the Drive link is publicly readable — a link that requires a sign-in
will be reported as a Caution.
